name: Power Amplifier - First Strike
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's First Strike capability.

61001.name: Power Boost III · First Strike

ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
